text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: —Is it about time, then?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
I've got somewhere to stop by today. It's 
a good opportunity. You come along too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having no plans in particular, I decided 
to tag along with Sirius Symboli.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...However, where she brought me was 
completely unexpected. There were so many 
famous faces from TV, I couldn't help but 
shrink back in intimidation—!"
choice_data_list: W-Why in a place like this...!?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
I heard some racing world bigwigs are 
coming. Wouldn't hurt to check out their 
mugs at least once, right?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
This should be a decent opportunity for 
you too. —Come on, let's go.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I followed behind Sirius Symboli as she 
greeted the invited guests— Yet, I still 
couldn't shake my anxiety.
choice_data_list:
(A-Am I sticking out like a sore 
thumb...?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —Just as I was worrying about that...

text_block_list.name: Burly Guest
text_block_list.text: Ah, so that's...

text_block_list.name: Slender Guest
text_block_list.text:
The unruly one from the Symboli family, 
you mean...? The one rumored to be 
ill-behaved...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I suddenly catch the sound of a negative 
voice.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking over, two of the guests were 
whispering in the distance. Sirius Symboli 
hadn't noticed them, but—
choice_data_list: (...I have a bad feeling about this.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As adults, our role is to watch over the 
Umamusume as they grow day by day.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She might advise them out of genuine 
concern, but she would never utter a 
single word to demean them.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Unable to contain my indignation, before 
I knew it, I was standing in front of the 
two of them.

text_block_list.name: Burly Guest
text_block_list.text:
...? What is this all of a sudden? More 
importantly, just who are you?
choice_data_list: I'm Sirius's Trainer! Nice to meet you!!

text_block_list.name: Burly Guest
text_block_list.text: —, Sirius Symboli's...? I-I see...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An indescribable atmosphere filled the 
room. The guests' gazes all focused 
directly on us.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: —Well, well.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Pardon my bad manners. I'm afraid I'm not 
well-versed in etiquette.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
That said—ordinarily, he's a frail puppy 
who isn't very good at biting.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"She wouldn't bare her fangs unless it was 
something extraordinary. ...Do you have 
any idea what might have caused this?"

text_block_list.name: Slender Guest
text_block_list.text: N-No... it's nothing. If you'll excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking as though they had nothing more to 
say, the invited guest walked away.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, getting rid of mice behind my 
back, are we? Where did you learn a trick 
like that?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
“It was clumsy, but not bad. I'll have to 
teach you how to sharpen those fangs of 
yours eventually.”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the past, I might have shrunk back and 
stayed silent. But she taught me how to 
carry myself with confidence, so—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I feel like I was able to speak up without 
hesitation this time.
choice_data_list:
I'll do a much better job supporting you 
from now on!
It's all thanks to what you taught me.
It's all thanks to you teaching me.
I just couldn't hold back anymore...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I feel like I was able to speak up without 
hesitation this time.
choice_data_list:
I'll do a much better job supporting you 
from now on!
It's all thanks to what you taught me.

I just couldn't hold back anymore...

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
You want to take me on? Hah, you're a 
hundred years too early. Don't let a fluke 
go to your head.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Well, if that "fluke" turns into the real 
deal someday—that might actually be pretty 
interestin', huh?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As Sirius Symboli spoke teasingly, she 
wore an amused expression.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I was the one who told you. But you 
were the one who carried it out.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"You looked way more dignified than they 
did. ...Take pride in that."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sirius Symboli seemed impressed that what 
she had taught was remembered.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Then folks might start saying you've 
got "bad behavior" from now on too.
choice_data_list:
If I'm with you, everything will be 
fine... maybe!

If I'm with you, everything will be 
fine... maybe!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"Haaah? ...Good grief, what a weird way to 
show you're happy."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though she spoke in a teasing tone, Sirius 
Symboli's voice sounded joyful.
